findings.title: The opening arrives as a bound beat
findings.claim: The particle bi reaches the immediately governed noun ism, so the formula opens as a joined relation before any governing act is stated.
findings.mechanism: Bi is bound to and governs ism; that contact makes dependence on the name audible in the first beat instead of presenting an independent assertion.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the formula's opening as already connected to the name.
findings.containment: This describes the local fused opening only; it does not supply a full overt clause or choose one governing act.

epistemic.reason: The supplied local analysis and formula support directly describe the bound particle and its dependence on the following name.

findings.title: The opening relation gathers several directions
findings.claim: Bi relates a supplied beginning or invocation to ism with instrumental, locative, accompanying, and binding pressure, so the act is felt through the name inside one governed phrase.
findings.mechanism: The particle's broad relational range contacts the immediately governed name noun and the compressed act supplied by the formula; the readings converge on the phrase's single relation rather than becoming separate propositions.
findings.reader_payoff: The act can feel performed by, in, and with the name while remaining one opening relation.
findings.containment: These values color the local relation; they do not assert four separate actions or an independent clause.

epistemic.reason: The supplied particle analysis and its support explicitly retain the relational range while limiting it to the governed construction.

findings.title: The act stays compressed through the name

findings.mechanism: The particle opens a dependent phrase rather than an assertion, and the construct relation routes the supplied act through ism to Allah.
findings.reader_payoff: The formula leaves the act open while giving it a local path through the name.
findings.containment: Beginning, reciting, and invoking remain alternative ways to supply the compressed act; none is selected as the only one.

epistemic.reason: The support directly connects the bound particle, formulaic ellipsis, genitive government, and the reader-supplied act.

findings.title: The name marks its referent as distinct

findings.reader_payoff: Naming feels like an act of bringing the referent into distinct focus, not a neutral label detached from it.
findings.containment: The focus supports designation and source-reported distinctness; it does not present literal elevation or a physical mark.

epistemic.reason: The ordinary name sense is explicit, while the raised-or-marked force is a source-reported root explanation retained as color.
